note: OUT-OF-SAMPLE POOL: folds 0 and 1 are the two folds scripts/newfault_detector.py excluded from every NFF member's training geography (trainable = valid & ~(fold0 | fold1)), so no member saw this ground. Folds 2 and 3 are IN-SAMPLE for the members and are reported separately, never pooled here.
